# Read data

```{r specify-path}
#resultsFolder = "../../../cpp/netlings2.0/"
path = paste0("../../../results/preliminary_20220926/")

# read results
#allNetsResults <- read.table(paste0(path, "/allNetsResults_prepped.txt"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

# read params
params <- read.table(file = paste0(path, "paramsScalarSel"), 
                     sep = " ", header = FALSE, col.names = c("param", "val"))
num_nodes = params$val[params$param == "NUM_NODES"]
num_generations = params$val[params$param == "NUM_GENERATIONS"]

# names
node_names = paste("G", 1:num_nodes, sep = "")
genotypesColnames <- paste("G_", node_names, sep = "")
phenotypesColnames <- paste("P_", node_names, sep = "")
sBasalColnames <- paste("S_", node_names, sep = "")
```

## Load packages & misc

```{r load-packages}
# Package list
packages <- c("dplyr",
              "nlme", 
              "MuMIn", # for r.squared in lme models
              "ggplot2",
              "ggpubr", # for the pubclean theme
              "ggridges", 
              "gridExtra",
              "cowplot", # for arranging plots
              "infotheo",
              "lme4", 
              "car", # for vif measure
              "RColorBrewer", # for color palettes
              "latex2exp", # for latex notation in the plots
              "reshape2", 
              "formattable", # for nice tables
              "htmltools", # for outputting the table
              "webshot") # for outputting the table

# Install packages not yet installed
installed_packages <- packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())
if (any(installed_packages == FALSE)) {
  install.packages(packages[!installed_packages])
}

# Packages loading
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE))

# colors for plots
noiseColor = "#01665e"
genotypeNoiseColor = "#7b3294"
genotypeSBasalColor = "#08519c"
phenotypeColor = "#d95f0e"
fitnessColor = "#e78ac3"
neutralityColor = "darkgray"
customGreenAIC = "#41ab5d"
```



# Directional selection on one gene

```{r add-optimal-expression-level-stab}
sEq = 50.4727
sOpt = sEq + 30
```

## Twenty genes

```{r read-data}
# read hist file
histFile <- read.table(file = paste0(path, "fossilsTwentyGenesDirLong.hist"), sep = " ", header = FALSE)
colnames(histFile) <- c("generation", "cell", "IDGenotype", "IDNet", "IDNoise", "IDSBasal", phenotypesColnames, "fitness")
histFile$scen <- "selection"

# read noises file
noisesIDFile <- read.table(file = paste0(path, "fossilsTwentyGenesDirLong.noises"), sep = " ", header = FALSE)
noisesIDFile <- noisesIDFile[, -dim(noisesIDFile)[2]]
colnames(noisesIDFile) <- c("IDNoise", genotypesColnames)

# read sbasals file
sBasalsIDFile <- read.table(file = paste0(path, "fossilsTwentyGenesDirLong.sbasals"), sep = " ", header = FALSE)
sBasalsIDFile <- sBasalsIDFile[, -dim(sBasalsIDFile)[2]]
colnames(sBasalsIDFile) <- c("IDSBasal", sBasalColnames)

# merge
noisesHist <- inner_join(histFile[, c("generation", "cell", "IDNoise")], noisesIDFile, by = "IDNoise")
sBasalsHist <- inner_join(histFile[, c("generation", "cell", "IDSBasal")], sBasalsIDFile, by = "IDSBasal")
```

```{r plot}
plot_noiseGenotypeDynamics_TwentyGenesDir <- ggplot(noisesHist, aes(x = generation, y = G_G1)) + 
  geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.01, color = genotypeNoiseColor) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun.y = median, geom = "line", size = 1, color = genotypeNoiseColor) +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=12, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold")) +
  labs(subtitle = paste0("Directional selection, 20 genes selected"),
       x = "Generations", y = "Intrinsic noise parameter") + 
  ylim(0, max(noisesHist$G_G1))
plot_noiseGenotypeDynamics_TwentyGenesDir

plot_sBasalsGenotypeDynamics_TwentyGenesDir <- ggplot(sBasalsHist, aes(x = generation, y = S_G1)) + 
  geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.01, color = genotypeSBasalColor) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun.y = median, geom = "line", size = 1, color = genotypeSBasalColor) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = sOpt) +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=12, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold")) +
  labs(subtitle = paste0(""), x = "Generations", y = "Basal expression level") + 
  ylim(0, 100)
plot_sBasalsGenotypeDynamics_TwentyGenesDir

plot_phenotypeDynamics_TwentyGenesDir <- ggplot(histFile, aes(x = generation, y = P_G1)) + 
  geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.01, color = phenotypeColor) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun.y = median, geom = "line", size = 1, color = phenotypeColor) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = sOpt) +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=12, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=16, face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10, face="bold")) +
  labs(subtitle = paste0(""), x = "Generations", y = "Expression level") + 
  ylim(0, 100)
plot_phenotypeDynamics_TwentyGenesDir
```

# Final plot

```{r final-plot}
plot_joint <- cowplot::plot_grid(plot_noiseGenotypeDynamics_TwentyGenesDir,
                                 plot_sBasalsGenotypeDynamics_TwentyGenesDir,
                                 plot_phenotypeDynamics_TwentyGenesDir,
                                 scale = c(0.95, 0.95, 0.95),
                                 labels = "AUTO",
                                 label_size = 20,
                                 label_fontface = "bold",
                                 ncol = 1)
ggsave(filename = sprintf("plot_directional_longRun.png"),
       plot = plot_joint, 
       bg = "white",
       path = path, 
       device = "png", 
       scale = 2, height = 15, width = 6, units = "cm",
       dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE)
```
